data.body: AC amendment (gap finding 1): Disambiguate <HARD-GATE> insertion point. SKILL.md has three <HARD-GATE> blocks (lines 16-18, 145-147, 373-375). Insert after the top-level one (immediately before '## Layout') using a multi-line old_string anchor that includes the closing </HARD-GATE> plus the next line '## Layout' to guarantee uniqueness for the Edit tool.
